method: v8.74 wide all-outcomes incremental tier with frozen v8.64 deployment
anti_leakage: Existing deployment months reuse the immutable v8.64 multiplier table. A missing calendar month is computed from unchanged v8.60 matched cross-cost evidence strictly before that month; incremental positions never select their own multiplier.

closing_value.guardrail: Post-settlement attribution only; closing prices and outcomes never alter eligibility, direction, or stake.

closing_expected_monthly_stability.guardrail: Closing prices are attribution-only and cannot change frozen eligibility, direction or stake. Match outcomes are not used by this diagnostic.
